# CYCLE001 arch-import-cycle

Crates (or files, outside any crate) that import each other.

## What it does

Builds the import graph between crates (a file outside any crate is its own node) from the Must import, call and reference edges that cross nodes and fires once per cycle, naming every member. Unresolved when the cycle exists only if a May import edge is taken. Unknown edges name no target and are ignored.

## Why it matters

Crates that import each other cannot be built, tested or reasoned about one at a time; the cycle is one unit in disguise.

## Remedy

Move the shared part into a crate both depend on, or invert one dependency.

## Examples

### Fires case 1

```toml expect=fire file=Cargo.toml config="cycle"
[workspace]
members = ["a", "b"]
```

### Clean case 2

```toml expect=clean file=Cargo.toml config="chain"
[workspace]
members = ["a", "b"]
```
